The '''Weemell sector''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Loedorvia system/Legends|Loedorvia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which in turn was the site of the celestial body [[Loedorvia]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and was home to a population of [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="CSWE BrainrotPlague">{{CSWECite|I|90|Brainrot Plague (Loedorvian Brain Plague; Brainworm Rot)}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Loedorvia was situated within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20.2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], which&mdash;along with the [[Battle of Loedorvia]]&mdash;is established by ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' to have been a part of [[Operation Durge's Lance]], to [[20 BBY/Legends|20.2 BBY]].</ref> the astronomical object was the site of<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Battle of Loedorvia|battle]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During that confrontation, Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] ordered the release of<ref name="Season1" /> the [[Atmosphere/Legends|airborne]]<ref name="CSWE BrainrotPlague" /> [[hive virus]]<ref name="Season1" /> [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as the [[Brainrot Plague]]<ref name="CSWE BrainrotPlague" /> on Loedorvia.<ref name="TEA" />

The release of the disease, also known as the Loedorvian Brain Plague, [[Death/Legends|killed]] tens of thousands of individuals in a single stroke.<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref> Before an [[Antidote/Legends|antidote]] could be discovered,<ref name="Season1" /> the resulting outbreak of the disease exterminated all of the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]]&mdash;as well as nearly every Human&mdash;in the Weemell [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="CSWE BrainrotPlague" /> The sector was also rendered temporarily uninhabitable as a result.<ref name="CSWE LoedorvianBrainPlague">{{CSWECite|II|259|Loedorvian Brain Plague}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Weemell sector was first mentioned in [[Curtis Saxton]]'s [[2005]] [[Book/Legends|reference book]] ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''.<ref name="RotSCross">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Loedorvia [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square K-12.<ref name="TEA Loedorvia" />
